desktop.notesZh:
桌面 exe 图标换成客户的 logo：exe、窗口、托盘三处同步。
首次进入「项目工程」不再闪错误：读取串行化，只有最新一次读取能作数；激活期的预读失败不再回答页面；已显示的内容不会被一次失败读清空，失败变成内容旁边的一行提示。
指令集卡片改版：品牌色条 + 指令名 mono 标签 + 星级徽标 + 「功能 / 运行结果」并排，不再是一堵四行文字。
「置信度」在变更分类卡片上直接写明是什么、有什么用：它是系统对「该走哪条路径」的把握（命中关键词直接给 100%，关键词定不了时由大模型评估并给出真实的推荐百分比），只影响系统的最初建议，路由由你在分类卡上点。
会话工作流图的产物标签改回文件名（plan.md / checklist.md）；「阶段产物」的状态列统一三个字并右对齐（未生成 / 未填写 / 已计划 / 已填写 / 已裁剪），已修改 / 待同步 / 已同步 同样右对齐；变更详情页同步。
确认门的每个选项都有一句白话解释（弹窗、工作流页签的待决门、确认门台账三处一致），不再只有「暂不推进」有说明。
变更域确认门只弹一次：模型没给变更号时系统自行解析当前变更，同一会话同一张门不互相覆盖。
上游文档是基准：阶段定稿后模型不得改写 proposal.md / clarify.md / design.md，要改就改下游文档；客户自己改上游后按「同步」重写下游照旧可用。
「实现已完成 · 请确认进入验证」按检查单就绪判定：进不去时不再出现点不动的按钮；测试流被启用后会真的跑；归档必须经过客户确认，一次只出现一个归档确认。
启动页的慢启动提示行与金色 logo 之间留出了间距（面板加高到 340，logo 组下移），两者不再挤在一起。
所有图标去掉白色底板：exe、任务栏、托盘、网站与安装包图标恢复为透明背景的鲸鱼标（图形与描边保持原样，只把白底变成透明）。
分类置信度不再只有 70% / 40% 两档：关键词（中英文都可命中）直接给 100%，关键词定不了时由大模型给出真实的推荐百分比；确认门上被推荐的路径带「推荐」标记。
工作流图顶部的「变更耗时」改为「会话耗时」，只统计干活的时间，不含你在确认门上的等待。
阶段产物走一条六态阶梯：未生成（灰）→ 未填写（黄）→ 已填写（蓝）→ 已完成（绿）；已完成的文档被锁死，模型不得改写；确认后又被改动就是「已更新」（橙），其后的文档是「待更新」（红），并弹出同步提示。
澄清阶段可以真的填写 proposal.md（此前上游锁把提案挡在澄清阶段之外），确认门通过后提案即定稿。
desktop.notesEn:
The desktop exe now carries the customer logo (exe, window and tray).
The project page no longer flashes an error on the first visit: the reads are sequenced, only the newest answer paints, the activation-time warm-up no longer answers the page, and a failed read never clears content that is already on screen — it becomes a notice beside it.
The instruction cards are cards now: a brand accent bar, the command id in a mono chip, the help-table rating as a badge, and the mechanism / outcome lines side by side.
Confidence says what it is and what it is for, on the classification card: how strongly the system believes the path it recommends (a keyword hit answers 100%; when the keywords cannot decide the model evaluates and returns a real percentage). It only shapes the first suggestion — the path is the one you pick on the classification card.
The flow graph names documents by file name again (plan.md / checklist.md). The stage-artifact state column is three characters wide and right-aligned (未生成 / 未填写 / 已计划 / 已填写 / 已裁剪), and the drift tags ride the same right edge. The change detail page matches.
Every confirmation-gate option carries one plain sentence saying what the click does — the dialog, the workflow tab pending gate and the gate ledger all read the same hint.
A change-scoped gate pops once: when the model omits the change id the system resolves the active change itself, and a second pop of the same gate stands down instead of covering the answer.
The upstream document is the basis: once a stage settled, the model may not rewrite proposal.md / clarify.md / design.md — the downstream document adapts instead. The customer editing an upstream document and pressing 同步 still works.
The implement-to-verify confirm now judges the checklist: when the change may not advance, the button is not offered. An enabled test flow really runs, and the archive waits for the customer's confirmation — one archive confirmation at a time.
The splash gives the mark room: the slow-start hint row and the golden logo no longer share one crowded band (the panel grew to 340px and the logo group moved down).
Every icon lost its white plate: the exe, taskbar, tray, website and installer icons are transparent artwork again — the same whale, only the white square behind it is gone.
The classification confidence is no longer two fixed tiers (70% / 40%): a keyword hit — Chinese included — answers 100%, and when the keywords cannot decide the model returns a real recommended percentage. The confirmation gate marks the recommended path with a 「推荐」 badge.
The workflow graph's top strip reads 「会话耗时」 and counts the work only — the customer's waiting at a confirmation gate is not work.
The stage artifacts walk one six-state ladder: 未生成 (grey) → 未填写 (amber) → 已填写 (blue) → 已完成 (green). A confirmed document is frozen (the model may not rewrite it); a confirmed document edited afterwards reads 已更新 (orange), the documents after it read 待更新 (red), and the workflow asks for the sync.
The clarify stage can really fill proposal.md — the upstream lock used to keep the proposal out of its reach — and passing the clarify gate finalizes it.

dsh.notesEn: Upstream DeepSeek Harness runtime (session, tools, Web GUI)

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-core.notesEn: Baseline loader, adapter stubs, bafCore isolate mount; two/three-grade TierMode + coercion; dead Worker-grade keyword rules filtered out (a low keyword never changes the outcome under escalateOnly and first-match shadowed real escalations; mid coerces to low in two-grade mode), low-tier preset pack routineEdits removed; batch 37 adds artifact-lifecycle: the shared six-state document ladder (未生成/未填写/已填写/已完成/已更新/待更新) and its lock table

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-workflow.notesZh: projection、intake、transition、工作流 Tab Remote；full-go-path 七阶段 + drift/abandon/T11；Phase 6 bug 快路径与 T15 升级；Phase 7 verify CheckRunner 接入 stack/guard adapter；§22.17 J：分类弹窗两路径改道（intake-mode-set）+ 缺陷草案五字段 + auto-pop 宿主行（状态驱动自动弹）+ 门弹窗通道；卡死修复 A–G：/baf-go 直绑唯一活跃变更、铸造设焦点、已确认未 open 不重弹、Tab 恢复按钮、mode= 硬要求、setIntakeMode 补救臂、git_unavailable 审计；OpenSpec×Matt 融合：会话提示词节 baf:standard-rules 每回合注入工程规则源；effectiveRouteKeywordRules 透传 tierMode（死规则过滤随档位模式生效）；批次二十四新增 formatDraft Remote（会话自己的模型整理草稿，一次 purpose=draft-format 辅助调用）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-workflow.notesEn: Projection, intake, transition, workflow tab Remote; full-go-path seven stages + drift/abandon/T11; Phase 6 bug fast path and T15 escalation; Phase 7 verify CheckRunner wires stack/guard adapters; §22.17 J: clickable path re-routing in the classify dialog (intake-mode-set) + five-field bug draft + auto-pop host row (state-driven auto popup) + gate dialog channel; OpenSpec×Matt fusion: the baf:standard-rules session section injects the standards source every turn; effectiveRouteKeywordRules passes tierMode through so dead-rule filtering follows the active grade mode; batch 24 adds the formatDraft Remote (the session's own model arranges the draft in one purpose=draft-format auxiliary call)

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-openspec.notesZh: OpenSpec 本地文件适配器：骨架、校验、原子归档；design/tasks 模板 TODO 提示规则源锚点（偏离需注明、测试遵循 testing-discipline）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-openspec.notesEn: Local file-mode OpenSpec adapter: skeleton, validate, atomic archive; design/tasks template TODOs point at the rules source anchors

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-standard.notesZh: 新增 enterprise-docs 资产目录与 enterpriseDoc RPC：11 份 bafplugin 迁移的真实企业规范文档随包资产发布（skills/sora-c-code-standards、sora-python-code-standards 等），浏览器端按 id 拉取全文；批次七增 QUALITY_DOCS（baf-quality 环境搭建/配置真资产）；批次八补迁 python SKILL + SRI checklist 逐字节修复 + test_module.template.c 编目（共 7 条质量文档）；摘要投影不变
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-standard.notesEn: New enterprise-docs asset catalog + enterpriseDoc RPC: eleven real bafplugin-migrated enterprise standard documents ship as package assets (skills/sora-c-code-standards, sora-python-code-standards, ...) served by id to the browser; batch seven adds QUALITY_DOCS (real baf-quality env/config assets); batch eight migrates the python SKILL + byte-exact SRI checklist fix + test_module.template.c cataloging (seven quality docs total); summary projection unchanged

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-quality.notesZh: C 栈质量执行器：build/test/coverage/analyzer 命令注入；占位态返回 policy_missing 与工具版本
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-quality.notesEn: C stack quality executor: build/test/coverage/analyzer command injection; placeholder state returns policy_missing and tool versions

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-guard.notesZh: 工具调用硬门禁：fs/shell 同步裁决 + projection 重读 + 密钥扫描 + 危险/间接 shell 模式识别；install row 注入每个 agent 的 tools.guard；§22.17 J 未决门期间拦截通用提问工具（gate_pending_ask_blocked）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-guard.notesEn: Tool-call hard gate: synchronous fs/shell adjudication + projection re-read + secret scan + dangerous/indirect shell pattern detection; install row hooks every agent's tools.guard

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-scaffold.notesZh: 工作区 init 骨架三产物：基线配置 + 默认工程规则文档（.baf/standards/default-rules.md）+ openspec 目录；人工确认才落盘，差异文件走 .baf-backup-<时间戳> 备份
